check.description: UI components and graphical objects (borders, states, focus indicators, icons that carry meaning) meet 3:1 against adjacent colours.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).

verified_by.mechanism: Brand/RAG/interactive-state tokens are contrast-checked at 3:1 against their worst-case dark surface (gates the build); joined down to component granularity via the token blast-radius reverse index.
verified_by.coverage: 6/8 applies_to components have a bound audited token
